prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A cute chibi cartoon giraffe rendered as a glossy, soft-plastic 3D toy character, centered in a square sticker-style composition on a plain flat pale background. The giraffe is extremely chubby and baby-proportioned: an oversized round head, a short thick neck, a plump pear-shaped body, stubby little arms with tiny hooves raised up in the air, and two small knob-tipped horns on top of its head plus wide floppy ears sticking out sideways. Its coat is bright saturated butter-yellow with soft rounded orange-tan giraffe patches, a big pale rounded muzzle with two dot nostrils, and a tiny tufted tail. The expression is explosive, unhinged joy: head thrown back and tilted upward, mouth stretched enormously wide open into a huge cavernous grin that takes up most of the face, showing a bright pink tongue and no scary teeth, cheeks puffed into round bulges, and both eyes squeezed completely shut into thin upward-curving happy crescents with long lashes. Two fat cartoon teardrops of laughter fly out from the corners of its eyes, and small motion squiggles around the body suggest it is shaking and wobbling with laughter. Simple clean cel-and-toy shading, soft studio lighting, bold smooth outlines, vivid cheerful colors, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.
